name: Tripping Riposte (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at tripping your opponents when you parry and counterattack.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Trip, riposte class feature

Benefit: When you successfully parry an opponent’s attack and make an attack of opportunity against the opponent, if you choose to try to trip your opponent, you gain a +1 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus per three levels of duelist that you possess. If you successfully trip your opponent, you may choose to have them fall prone in any square adjacent to you.
